en-GB.title: The Loyalty Loop
en-GB.subtitle: Loyalty cards for local shops
en-GB.description:
The Loyalty Loop turns the loyalty cards from your favourite local shops into one simple app.

Earn rewards at independent cafes, bakeries, restaurants, salons and studios near you. Every visit adds to your progress. When you reach the shop's goal, your reward unlocks in the app - show it at the till and enjoy.

HOW IT WORKS
- Discover: find local shops on a full-page map or a list, search by name or type, and see the closest first
- Collect: show your QR code or 6-character code when you pay and the shop adds your stamp or points
- Redeem: reach the goal and your reward unlocks instantly, with a QR code for the till

EVERYTHING IN THE APP
- Stamp cards, points and shop-designed programmes, each shown with a clear progress bar
- Your own customer card, and shops' own card designs
- Apple Wallet pass and a home-screen widget showing your next reward
- Favourite shops, kept at the top of your home page
- Shop news and offers, with push notifications you control
- Walk-past offers (optional): get one notification when you pass a shop with an offer. Needs location set to "Always" and you can switch it off any time
- Link a payment card to earn automatically at taking part shops, or add purchases by hand where automatic earning is not available
- Keep your other loyalty cards and barcodes in the same place
- Read and write reviews, and block people you do not want to see
- Ask for a shop to join: request your favourite local shop and see the ones you have asked for
- Ask Whirl, a friendly assistant that answers questions about your cards, rewards and shops
- Light, dark or match-your-phone appearance, and optional haptics
- Face ID, Touch ID or fingerprint app lock
- Sign in with Apple, Google or email
- Help and FAQ, contact support, privacy controls, and delete your account at any time

No paper cards to lose. No plastic. Just support your high street and get rewarded for it.

The Loyalty Loop is completely free, with no ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases, and we never sell your data.
en-GB.releaseNotes: New in this version: optional walk-past offers from shops you pass, light/dark/match-your-phone appearance, Ask Whirl, a refreshed look with new icons, and a lot of polish across the app.
en-GB.promoText: Completely free. Earn real rewards at independent cafes, bakeries and salons near you, just by visiting as usual. No more paper cards to lose.
